# VISTAR — Custom AI Software & Enterprise Web Engineering
> VISTAR is a custom software engineering company that builds AI agents, enterprise Next.js web applications, and interactive 3D WebGL experiences. Every project is fully owned by the client — 100% source code handover, no vendor lock-in.

## What We Build

### Custom AI Agent Development
- Autonomous multi-agent workflow systems
- LLM application development (GPT, Claude, Gemini integrations)
- Private Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines deployed in client VPCs
- Real-time telemetry anomaly detection (Isolation Forest, streaming ML)
- Enterprise AI automation and API orchestration
- See: https://www.vistar.tech/services/ai-solutions

### Enterprise Next.js & React Engineering
- Custom enterprise web applications using Next.js App Router and React 19
- Sub-100ms TTFB edge-optimized platforms with Core Web Vitals compliance
- TypeScript-first, fully typed codebases with automated testing
- Migration from legacy stacks (WordPress, Webflow, custom PHP) to Next.js
- See: https://www.vistar.tech/services/nextjs-engineering

### Interactive 3D WebGL Development
- 60fps Three.js and WebGL interactive experiences
- Custom GLSL shader pipelines and procedural geometry
- 3D product configurators for e-commerce and real estate
- Browser-based architectural visualization platforms
- React Three Fiber (R3F) component architectures
- See: https://www.vistar.tech/services/interactive-3d

## Production Systems (Live Portfolio)

### Project VAYU — Aviation Cockpit Telemetry
- Real-time GIS vector hazard layers and automated NOTAM threat extraction
- Sub-45ms situational awareness latency
- Live: https://ai-vayu.vercel.app
- Case study: https://www.vistar.tech/work

### AURA — Multi-Agent Biometric Anomaly Detection
- Healthcare IoT telemetry with Isolation Forest unsupervised ML
- Real-time biometric data streaming and multi-agent coordination
- Live: https://multi-agent-anomaly-system.onrender.com
- Case study: https://www.vistar.tech/work

### 3axis Arc — Spatial Architectural 3D Platform
- Next.js 16 platform with 60fps WebGL perspective transformations
- Sub-85ms global TTFB for high-end real estate and architecture clients
- Live: https://3axisarc.vercel.app
- Case study: https://www.vistar.tech/work

## Engineering Principles
- **100% Source Code Ownership**: Every line of code committed to your private GitHub repository on day one.
- **No Vendor Lock-In**: No proprietary CMS, no SaaS hostage fees, no hidden maintenance contracts.
- **14–21 Day Production Sprints**: Fixed-scope engagements with milestone reviews, automated testing, and staging delivery.
- **Performance-First**: Sub-2.5s LCP, 98+ Lighthouse P95, sub-100ms TTFB as standard targets.
- **Senior Engineers Direct Access**: No account managers. No offshore anonymity. Direct Slack access to principal engineers.
